stem.text: Which statement about telomeres is correct?

A.text: They allow cells in culture from any age of donor to divide a fixed number of times.

B.text: They are genes which are present on the 5′ end of every chromosome.

C.text: They are unpaired regions of DNA on the 3′ end of every chromosome.

D.text: They prevent introns and exons being lost from genes during cell division.
